articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and 3D
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, video streams, and 3D scene representations in a single context window. Benchmarks show a 40% improvement over GPT-5 on complex software engineering tasks and spatial reasoning. The model is available through the API with a 1M-token context and significantly reduced latency compared to its predecessor.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Graduate-Level Science Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which surpasses all existing models on GPQA Diamond and newly introduced graduate-level STEM benchmarks, approaching expert-level performance in physics and molecular biology. The model leverages a novel mixture-of-experts architecture with dynamic expert routing that reduces compute costs by 30%. Google is integrating it across Workspace products and making it available to enterprise Cloud customers.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Pilot Deployment in BMW and Amazon Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla's third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has entered real-world pilot programs at BMW manufacturing facilities in South Carolina and Amazon fulfillment centers. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22 degrees of freedom per hand and can autonomously learn new pick-and-place tasks via a few demonstrations. Early reports indicate the robots sustain roughly 20 hours of operation per charge with a failure intervention rate below 2%.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Manufacturing
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round led by Microsoft and Nvidia, valuing the company at $12 billion. The funding will be used to build a dedicated humanoid robot factory in Texas with a target capacity of 10,000 units per year by late 2027. Figure's robots have been operating in commercial logistics environments and recently demonstrated autonomous staircase navigation and multi-robot coordination in unstructured settings.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Oversight Framework Adopted by EU AI Office
articles.summary: Anthropic published a formal Constitutional AI Oversight protocol that provides a structured methodology for auditing frontier AI systems against safety constraints. The EU AI Office has adopted a variant of this framework as a recommended compliance pathway under the EU AI Act for high-risk general-purpose AI models. The framework includes automated red-teaming pipelines, interpretability dashboards, and standardized risk scoring that third-party auditors can use.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production on A14 2nm Node with GAA Transistors for AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed volume production on its A14 2nm process node using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors, with initial shipments destined for next-generation AI accelerator chips from Nvidia and Apple. The node delivers an estimated 15% speed improvement and 30% power reduction versus the N3E process. This milestone is expected to enable a new generation of datacenter GPUs capable of significantly higher throughput for large-scale model training.

articles.title: Meta Unveils Orion AR Glasses Consumer Edition with On-Device LLM Integration
articles.summary: Meta officially launched the consumer version of its Orion augmented reality glasses, featuring a custom silicon chip running a distilled Llama 4 model entirely on-device for real-time contextual assistance. The glasses weigh 68 grams and offer a 70-degree diagonal field of view with waveguide optics. On-device processing ensures low latency and privacy-preserving AI, with capabilities including real-time translation, object identification, and spatial navigation overlays.

articles.title: Startup Physical Intelligence Demonstrates General-Purpose Robot Foundation Model Transferring Across 50+ Task Families
articles.summary: Physical Intelligence (Pi) published research demonstrating its robot foundation model π-2 generalizing across more than 50 manipulation and locomotion task families with zero-shot or few-shot transfer. The model was trained on a diverse dataset spanning simulation and real-world teleoperation data from multiple robot morphologies. Results show that a single policy checkpoint can control both bimanual arms and quadrupeds, marking a significant step toward truly general-purpose robotic intelligence.
